title: Choose the price-data source once, in writing
why_now: R-03 is open and every blocked gate (G1, CLV, ROI, escrow) is downstream of the same decision.
path_a: Keep the community archive as the only price tier, publish it as research, and forbid any 'odds' wording in strict tables.
path_b: Purchase or license an authenticated operator feed for the fixtures we originate, and let G1 pass.
path_c: Do not price at all this season: originate lines, score them with proper scores against results, and keep ROI out of the vocabulary.
gate_it_opens: G1 for all 18 candidates; every CLV row
risk: B without a contract risks a terms-of-use problem; A keeps the site honest but leaves the competition unfunded

title: Decide whether the pin may move, and on what schedule
why_now: R-04 is only partly met because re-pricing changes every published number, which sessions have refused to do silently.
path_a: Freeze the pin for the season; publish residuals from the frozen snapshot only, with the pin commit on every page.
path_b: Re-pin on a fixed cadence (e.g. each Thursday), re-verify and re-publish, and let the number history be visible in git.
path_c: Re-pin only when a fixture week is settled, so a backtest and its pin move together.
gate_it_opens: the freshness of every price and schedule row
cost: 0 for A, engineering time for B/C
risk: B moves published numbers, which the executive summary must then restate; A ages

title: Run the two total estimators head-to-head and then collapse
why_now: R-08: both totals exist as fields; nothing declares a winner, so users must read two numbers with no adjudication.
path_a: Leave both, publish the gap column per game, no winner declared.
path_b: Walk-forward comparison on the same game set with a paired bootstrap interval on the skill difference; retire the loser only when the interval excludes zero.
path_c: Blend the two and publish one number (loses the auditability the brief asks for).
gate_it_opens: nothing; it improves the pricing view
risk: B needs the games to be settled; a premature collapse throws away an estimator that may win later

title: Two-stage leaderboard: proper-score qualification, then prospective CLV/ROI in escrow
why_now: R-11 and R-66 both stop at the same wall: no executable prices.
path_a: Keep the current single-stage standings (rank on gates passed), and say plainly that no ROI stage exists.
path_b: Build stage 1 now (Brier/log-score qualification per division with a game-clustered lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment), and open stage 2 escrow only for strategies that pass stage 1 AND have a price tier.
path_c: Run both stages on research prices and label the whole board research.
gate_it_opens: the 'no backtest number on the leaderboard' rule survives in all three paths
risk: B publishes an escrow row with no money in it, which a reader may misread as a promise
state: PROPOSED — the brief's own design, staged not built

title: Reserve a final holdout season by name
why_now: R-18: the build is walk-forward but nothing is untouched, so a season-long surprise cannot be distinguished from a tuned result.
path_a: Declare 2026 the holdout and freeze every fitted artefact at the 2025 season.
path_b: Declare one earlier season (e.g. 2019) the holdout, and keep 2026 as the live prospective sample.
path_c: Keep expanding-window only, and accept that no number here is a true holdout.
gate_it_opens: the 'is this skill or tuning' question
risk: A removes the current season from fitting, which weakens the model; C keeps the ambiguity

title: Ablations instead of fixed injury penalties, on the availability join
why_now: R-44 and the brief's 'injury and personnel ablations' items; 0 grep hits for 'ablation' in the repository, and the models are full-strength.
path_a: Keep fixed penalties out, publish nothing new, and let the ratings stay full-strength.
path_b: Join the dated availability capture into the feature frame as optional columns, then score the identical model with and without them on chronological holdouts, reporting the difference with an interval.
path_c: Build player-level bottom-up ratings (needs snaps; R-24/R-57 block it).
gate_it_opens: the claim 'injuries are modelled' — path B makes it true, path A makes it honest
cost: engineering for B; licensing for C
risk: B's interval will likely straddle zero on 7 days of availability history; publishing that is fine, suppressing it is not
state: PROPOSED — blocked on R-31 (inactive lists) for the confirming half

title: Put the captures somewhere private, keep the analysis public
why_now: R-61 and R-60: today the repository is both the store and the published site.
path_a: Keep the captures in-repo, and read the club and league terms before any further republication.
path_b: Move raw captures to a private store (bucket or second repository) and publish only derived, row-level-free tables.
path_c: Publish derived tables only, and keep raw pages out of git from the next capture forward.
gate_it_opens: nothing in the gates; it is a terms and durability decision
risk: B/C break the ability of a reader to reproduce our exact tables; A may find the terms forbid what we already do
state: PROPOSED — this session changed nothing, and flagged the conflict instead

title: Pair the official roof designation with a forecast before pricing any total
why_now: R-64: totals are the market most exposed to weather and roof state, and we currently hold neither at a known lead time.
path_a: Ignore weather in the originated totals and say so on the lines page.
path_b: Capture the official roof/surface designation at the printed lead time, plus one forecast row, and publish both as features with their clock times.
path_c: Capture only the roof designation (no forecast) and use it as a switch, not a model term.
gate_it_opens: a total-origination feature that is currently absent
cost: 0 for A/C, API work for B
risk: B adds a dependency on an external forecast provider whose terms are unread

title: Decide how to treat the one club that publishes depth as an image
why_now: R-32/R-36: 31 of 32 clubs have a verified structured chart; Houston does not, and the club page was confirmed image-only on 2026-11-18 (C-05).
path_a: Exclude HOU from every depth-derived feature, published as an explicit exclusion with the reason.
path_b: Ask for / license a structured Houston depth source and keep waiting.
path_c: Transcribe the image by eye (the brief explicitly rejects this: 'not transcription by eye').
gate_it_opens: the '32 verified clubs' gate on the backup-deficiency feature
risk: A leaves one club's opponents without a deficiency read; C is refused
state: PROPOSED — A is the only path consistent with the evidence policy

title: Replace the '136-game log' reference with an artefact name
why_now: R-62 / C-14: a requirement cannot be verified against a number that matches nothing in the repository.
path_a: Restate the requirement as 'the forward ledger as it stands' and link the file.
path_b: Point it at a committed CSV of settled games (results_feed) and give the row count in the requirement text.
path_c: Leave it; keep the register row as an unverified reference and block the corpus item.
risk: A/B change requirement text, which the owner owns; C keeps an unverifiable line on the board
